text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Satsuki Sho, the 
first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, was 
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand was overwhelmed by 
Duramente's aura during the race, and by 
the unyielding rivals who refused to lose 
their fighting spirit in the face of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wishing she could instill confidence in 
Cheval Grand someday, she returned with 
her to the waiting room.
